string.blacklistaddask: Add the target actor to the blacklist?
string.blacklistadddone: Target actor has been added to the blacklist.
string.blacklistaddinfo: Blacklists the target actor using its ActorBase.
string.blacklistinputinfo:
ActorBases to exclude: FormID (0001A67C) or EditorID (Nazeem), comma separated.
Empty means no exclusions. You can also add the crosshair target from the F1 menu.
string.blacklistremoveask: Remove the target actor from the blacklist?
string.blacklistremovedone: Target actor has been removed from the blacklist.
string.blacklistremoveinfo: Removes the target actor from the blacklist using its ActorBase.
string.logallowplayerinfo:
If enabled, allows the log to intercept the Player's death.
Default: OFF
string.logcreaturesinfo:
If enabled, death of creatures will be logged.
Default: ON
string.logenabledinfo:
If enabled, deaths of NPCs will be logged.
Default: ON
string.logplayerkillinfo:
If enabled, NPCs killed by the Player will be logged.
Default: ON
string.loguniqueonlyinfo:
If enabled, only deaths of NPCs with the Unique flag will be logged.
Default: ON
string.logwritetofileinfo:
If enabled, NPC deaths will be logged into a file.
The file will be located in Data/SKSE/Plugins/Obituary/Logs/<PlayerName>/<GameHour>.txt
Default: OFF
string.maxentriesperpageinfo:
How many entries are shown per page in the log browser.
Default: 16
string.maxlogsizeinfo:
The maximum amount of entries that can be logged into the MCM.
Higher values will cause longer processing times.
Default: 1024
string.menulogselect: Select an entry on the left
string.menurelvalues: -4 Archnemesis / -3 Enemy / -2 Foe / -1 Rival / 0 Acquaintance / 1 Friend / 2 Confidant / 3 Ally / 4 Lover
string.modenabledinfo: Whether the mod is active or not.
string.notenoughdragonsouls: You do not have enough dragon souls to resurrect %s.
string.notifcreaturesinfo:
If enabled, you will be notified of creature deaths.
Default: ON
string.notificationenabledinfo:
If enabled, you will be notified of the deaths of NPCs.
Default: OFF
string.notifmethodinfo:
The method to use for notifying the Player of a death.
Default: Message Box
string.notifminrelationshipinfo:
The minimum relationship rank required for a notification to show.
Default: 0 Acquaintance
string.notifplayerkillinfo:
If enabled, you will be notified of NPCs killed by the Player.
Default: OFF
string.notifresurrectdragonsoulcostinfo:
The amount of dragon souls required for the Resurrect option to work.
Default: 0
string.notifresurrectedkeepsitemsinfo:
If enabled, resurrected NPCs will have the same stuff they had before they were resurrected
instead of having a new set of items in their inventory.
Default: ON
string.notifresurrectoptioninfo:
If enabled, adds a Resurrect option in the death notification.
Default: OFF
string.notifteleportoptioninfo:
If enabled, adds a Teleport option in the death notification.
Default: OFF
string.notifteleportresurrectoptioninfo:
If enabled, adds a Teleport & Resurrect option: teleports you to the target and resurrects it only after you actually arrive.
Default: ON
string.notifuniqueonlyinfo:
If enabled, you will only be notified of the deaths of NPCs with the Unique flag.
Default: ON
string.processingsettingsmsg: A function of this mod is still processing.
string.tpnotarrived: Teleport did not complete; resurrect cancelled.
